name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 12, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Howard Amend, Board Member, Boys & Girls Club of Vista
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring Saturday, April 13, 2013, "Earth Day" in the City of Vista
P2.
Certificates of Appointment for incoming Commission/Committee members
P3.
Letter of Appreciation to Girl Scouts of San Diego in honor of the North Coastal Office opening
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer’s Cash Report for Month Ended January 31, 2013 (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Revenue Generating Ideas (CC)
D2.
Digital Message Boards (CC)
D3.
Paseo Santa Fe Streetscape Design and Infrastructure Plans (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Appeal of Planning Commission Denial of PC8-237, Chevron (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the appeal; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , denying the Special Use Permit (SUP) for alcoholic beverage sales for off-site consumption at an existing Chevron service station located at 2295 S. Melrose Drive.
PH2.
Agua Hedionda Creek Bridge (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a public hearing to accept comments on a proposal to construct a pedestrian bridge over Agua Hedionda Creek in Buena Vista Park; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the construction of a bridge within the Biological Preserve Overlay Zone and amending the FY 2012/13 Capital Improvement Program Budget.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
